vulnerable_code:
class PrescriptionDetailView(LoginRequiredMixin, DetailView):
    model = Prescription
    slug_field = 'rx_number'
    slug_url_kwarg = 'rx_number'
    template_name = 'prescriptions/detail.html'
    context_object_name = 'prescription'
diagnosis: The class-based DetailView looks up the Prescription by rx_number across all records in the database. Because it does not override get_queryset() to restrict records to the requesting user's patient profile, any authenticated user can view other patients' medication records.
